ValidationRule.description: QCC - Unable to edit cases that are not owned by the current user
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.Bypass_VR_for_QCC_Omnichannel_Supervisors = false, $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_QCC_Cannot_edit_cases_not_owned_by_us__c = TRUE, OwnerId <> $User.Id, BEGINS(OwnerId, '00G'), (NOW() - LastModifiedDate) > 0.0001133, NOT(ISCHANGED( OwnerId )), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Baggage', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Complaints', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Compliment', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Further_Action_Required', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Insurance_Letter_Case', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Medical', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_On_The_Spot_Recovery', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCC_Query', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Elite_Process', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Assistance', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Disruption', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QCC_Specific_Needs' ), OR( NOT(ISCHANGED(Status)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'In Progress'), BEGINS(OwnerId, '00G') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please take ownership of the case before making any changes.
